message.content: {"hts_code": "9018.19.9000", "reason": "Although marketed for users with disabilities, the device is a toilet seat with an integrated bidet functionally identical to general-purpose bidets, so it falls under the sanitary/hygiene apparatus heading; 9018.19.9000 is the residual code for other electro-medical/hygiene instruments, though classification under 3922.20 (bidet seats of plastics) or 6910.10 (ceramic sanitary fixtures) would be likely depending on construction and whether the disability-assistance exemption under HTSUS heading 9817 applies."}

predicted_reason: Although marketed for users with disabilities, the device is a toilet seat with an integrated bidet functionally identical to general-purpose bidets, so it falls under the sanitary/hygiene apparatus heading; 9018.19.9000 is the residual code for other electro-medical/hygiene instruments, though classification under 3922.20 (bidet seats of plastics) or 6910.10 (ceramic sanitary fixtures) would be likely depending on construction and whether the disability-assistance exemption under HTSUS heading 9817 applies.
